decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own product page, A appears to have enough initial strategic support and still too much unresolved market uncertainty to justify early withdrawal.
B has weaker commitment signals because it was only mentioned on the website, but after just one year the option value of learning more still outweighs the likely modest cost of keeping it available.
C combines a specific functional feature with dedicated website presentation, so management would likely keep this option open while demand evidence is still emerging.
D looks more experimental and had only limited website exposure, yet the information revealed so far is still too thin to justify abandoning it immediately.

E is a niche fabric with only limited website prominence and some overlap with other decorative launches, but a medium-sized textile firm would often allow one more year before fully closing this option.
